description: This file defines quantized batch normalization modules (BatchNorm2d and BatchNorm3d) for PyTorch, including methods for converting from float modules and reference modules, and handling quantization parameters.

classes.name: _BatchNorm
classes.description: Base class for quantized batch normalization, handling conversion from float modules and reference modules.

classes.name: BatchNorm2d
classes.description: Quantized version of torch.nn.BatchNorm2d with additional methods for quantization.

classes.name: BatchNorm3d
classes.description: Quantized version of torch.nn.BatchNorm3d with additional methods for quantization.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Converts a float batch norm module to a quantized batch norm module.

methods.name: from_reference
methods.description: Creates a quantized batch norm module from a reference batch norm module and quantization parameters.

methods.name: _get_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the quantized batch norm module.

methods.name: _check_input_dim
methods.description: Checks that the input tensor has the correct number of dimensions for 2D or 3D batch norm.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the batch normalization operation using quantized parameters.
